Hi Ines,

Great work today. Your serve toss was better in the second half. Before next time, try the toss drill twice at home, and I'll send a 15 minute video tonight.

No pressure if exams get in the way. I've attached a short routine you can use whenever you have ten minutes.

Coach Alex
